properties.comment: Crews are replacing equipment along Wireless Street, Sioux Falls, SD this Sunday, November 15th.  Power will be off starting at 7:30 a.m. for approximately 3 hours.  Call Dispatch at 1-800-234-1960 if you have any questions.  Thank you.
